Welcome aboard the Big Mohawk, where we invite you to experience the magic of the setting sun like never before. Our sunset cruises are designed to whisk you away on a serene and breathtaking adventure you'll cherish forever. As we glide along the water, you'll be treated to captivating views of the horizon. The tranquil beauty of the setting sun against the backdrop of the sea is a sight to behold. Whether you're seeking a romantic evening with a loved one or simply a peaceful escape from the daily grind, our Sunset Cruises provide the perfect atmosphere for relaxation and connection.
